description: Works out compound growth, what a fee costs over the years, what inflation does to cash, or how holding more things changes how much a mix swings, from numbers the person gives. Use it to show how money grows or shrinks over time with their own example. Pure arithmetic, drawn as a chart they can change in Claude; the rate is their assumption, never a forecast or a suggestion.

correlation.description: How closely holdings move together, -1 to 1 (diversification).

fee_pct.description: Yearly fee in percent of the balance (fees).

holdings.description: Show up to this many holdings, 2 to 100 (diversification; default 20).

inflation_pct.description: Yearly inflation to assume, in percent (inflation).

monthly.description: Optional amount added each month (compound_growth, fees).

rate_pct.description: Yearly return the person wants to assume, in percent (compound_growth, fees).

volatility_pct.description: How much one holding swings in a year, in percent (diversification).

name: money_maths
title: Money maths
